about: From the director of Madagascar and narrated by Ethan Hawke, INVASION! is a VR animation about a duo of aliens with grand ambitions to take over our world. Instead, they are greeted by two adorable, white bunnies….and YOU are one of them!
Official selection of Cannes Le Marché du Film, Toronto International Film Festival, and Tribeca Film Festival.
This product supports the following languages: English
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
